dcterms:description: The CoNLL 2003 dataset is a widely used benchmark for named entity recognition tasks, containing annotated text for identifying entities such as persons, organizations, and locations.
dcterms:title: CoNLL 2003 Dataset

dcterms:description: A new enriched semantic annotation of errors for the CoNLL 2003 dataset, along with new diagnostic datasets created to analyze and improve NER models.
dcterms:title: Enriched Semantic Annotation and Diagnostic Datasets
